run_fastapi_competition_app: run a FastAPI server that hosts a Hugging Face competition platform with OAuth login and submission endpoints
fetch_leaderboard_public_or_private: fetch the public or private leaderboard for a Hugging Face competition as a markdown table
submit_new_competition_entry: submit a new competition entry by uploading a file or providing a Hugging Face Hub model ID
update_selected_submissions_for_team: update which submissions a team has selected for final scoring by providing submission IDs
update_admin_competition_config: update competition configuration settings like submission limits, end date, and scoring metric as an admin
